points.text: M2: Val-Lys and Lys on the right of the cross (in any order)
M3: relative order of Val-Lys and Lys (on the same side of the cross)
M4: Val does not move as it is a zwitterion / neutral (at pH6) OR Lys / Val-Lys move towards negative (pole) as they are positively charged
M5: Lys moves the furthest as it has the lowest $M_r$ (with the same positive charge) OR Val-Lys moves the least as it has the largest $M_r$ (with the same positive charge)
